seo.seo_title: Digital Marketing Portfolio | Sanjari Recycling Success Story | Trivo
seo.seo_description:
Explore Trivo's digital marketing portfolio for Sanjari Recycling and
discover how our SEO, social media, and performance marketing
strategies increased online visibility, inquiries, and business growth.

sections.title: Sanjari Recycling
sections.body: Sanjari Recycling is a leading e-waste management company specializing in the safe collection, disposal, and recycling of electronic waste. As a trusted technology partner, Trivo IT Solution Pvt. Ltd. has helped them enhance their digital presence and streamline their online operations.

sections.title: SEO Implementation
sections.body:
The SEO campaign included:

• Keyword research for recycling industry queries
• On-page SEO optimization
• Technical SEO improvements
• Content development for recycling services
• Local SEO optimization

Higher rankings for recycling service keywords
• Improved organic search traffic
• Increased website engagement from targeted visitors
• Strengthened authority in the e-waste recycling industry

sections.title: Website Traffic Growth / Key Website Growth Metrics / Traffic Acquisition Insights

cards.title: Website Traffic Growth
cards.body:
The website experienced a significant increase in users during the SEO campaign.

• 7.5K active users recorded
• 7.5K new users acquired through search and digital channels
• 38K total event interactions on the website
• 65.8% growth in active users
• 67% increase in new users

These numbers highlight a strong improvement in website visibility and user acquisition.

sections.title: Paid Advertising Growth (Google Ads)
sections.body:
To accelerate lead generation for Sanjari Recycling, we launched a targeted Google Ads call campaign focused on high-intent keywords related to e-waste recycling services in Mumbai and surrounding cities.

Our strategy focused on:

• Local search intent targeting
• Call-based lead campaigns
• Geographic targeting for Mumbai–Pune industrial zones
• Optimized ad extensions and call assets

sections.title: Google Business Profile Growth
sections.body:
Local visibility was strengthened through optimization of the Google Business Profile for Sanjari Recycling.

We focused on improving discoverability in local map results for recycling services and increasing customer trust through reviews and profile engagement.

Google Business Profile Highlights

  • 4.2 ⭐ average rating
    • 82 verified customer reviews
    • Improved visibility in Google Maps results
    • Increased inbound phone inquiries from local searches

Profile optimization included:

• Business category optimization
• Service listing enhancements
• Local SEO keyword integration
• Customer review management

39.1 k followers

We helped Sanjari Recycling grow on Instagram with engaging eco-friendly content, creative reels, and strategic ad campaigns. Our data-driven approach boosted their reach, engagement, and brand awareness in the sustainability space.
